channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Juno Beach debates reinstalling fence at JB-7 beach access after resident complaints
item.description: Residents at the Colony Condos say beachgoers are cutting through their private property since Juno Beach removed a fence at the JB-7 public walkway in 2023. The town council will take up the fence question during budget discussions on July 15.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to receive 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: Riviera Beach was selected as one of just 10 communities nationwide to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League. The award recognizes communities that bring residents, local government, businesses and organizations together to solve local challenges.

item.title: Boca Raton High School band to represent Florida in National Independence Day Parade
item.description: The Boca Raton Community High School band will march in Washington D.C.'s National Independence Day Parade on July 4. The students will march a full mile along the National Mall, representing the entire state of Florida.

item.title: S.D. Spady Elementary in Delray Beach jumps from C to A rating
item.description: S.D. Spady Elementary School in Delray Beach made a dramatic leap from a C rating last year to an A this year, part of Palm Beach County schools earning a third consecutive A rating from the state. The district saw 143 schools rated A or B, up from 120 the previous year.

item.title: Hobe Sound community raises funds for man who lost fiance in deadly home fire
item.description: Friends in Hobe Sound have launched a fundraiser to help Mark rebuild after a fire Monday killed his fiance, Misty Dawn White, 46. Preliminary findings from the sheriff's office point to an electrical issue as a possible cause.

item.title: Breast cancer patient speaks out after insurance denies reconstruction surgery hours before procedure
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, and her surgeon are speaking out after Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield denied coverage for a breast reconstruction procedure less than 24 hours before it was scheduled. The denial involved a surgical mesh called GalaFlex that insurers say is still investigational.

item.title: Hobe Sound woman dies in house fire days before birthday, community rallies around fiance
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside the Hobe Sound home she shared with her fiance. Preliminary findings from the sheriff's office point to an electrical issue as a possible cause.

item.title: Martin County School Board fights judge's order to reinstate teacher suspended over Charlie Kirk Facebook post
item.description: The Martin County School Board filed a court challenge Thursday against an administrative law judge's recommendation to reinstate a teacher suspended last year .

item.title: Juno Beach fence dispute at JB-7 beach access could cost town thousands
item.description: Residents at the Colony Condos say people using the JB-7 public walkway are cutting through their private property since the town removed the old fence in 2023 for safety reasons. A fix could cost the town thousands of dollars.

item.title: Stuart downtown dock closes Sunday for $3 million renovation to nearly double boat slips
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock will close July 6 for renovations projected to be complete by next Fourth of July. When finished, the project will expand from 18 to 44 slips for both motorized and non-motorized vessels.

item.title: Port St. Lucie advances plans for Midway Road Turnpike interchange, wider roads
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance last month to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation to assist with a partial interchange at Midway Road and Florida's Turnpike.

item.title: Martin County maritime teams on standby for Fourth of July weekend boating safety
item.description: Martin County Maritime Response Unit will have two boats with medics on standby in the north and south of the county as hundreds of boaters hit the waterways to celebrate the Fourth of July weekend.

item.title: West Palm Beach to Palm Beach airport elevated transit system proposed to county
item.description: Glydways, a California-based autonomous transit company, is proposing an elevated network of self-driving vehicles that would connect downtown West Palm Beach to President Donald J. Trump International Airport in less than 10 minutes.

item.title: Anthem denies breast cancer patient's reconstruction surgery hours before procedure
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, was denied coverage for a breast reconstruction procedure less than 24 hours before it was scheduled. Her insurance company, Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield, said the surgical mesh involved is still considered investigational.

item.title: Port St. Lucie advances plan for new Florida Turnpike interchange at Midway Road
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation for a partial interchange at Midway Road and the Florida Turnpike.

item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock closes July 6 for a $3 million renovation projected to be complete by next Fourth of July.

item.title: Delray Beach golf training center delayed 3 months and costs owner $90,000 after contractor issues
item.description: Tom Molen, owner of Tee Box, a new virtual golf training and performance center near Delray Beach along Jog Road south of Linton Boulevard, said the project was delayed three months after problems with the contractor hired to prepare the space.

item.title: Hobe Sound community raises funds after woman dies in deadly home fire
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside her Hobe Sound home. Friends have launched a fundraiser to help White's fiance Mark rebuild after the flames destroyed many of his and White's belongings.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs rise 4% this year, ground beef and buns up most
item.description: A Fourth of July cookout for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4% from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey.

item.description: Stephen McCoy, a disabled and retired veteran in Lantana, turned to WPTV for help with a roofing contractor he said left him with unfinished repairs and a lien on his home.

item.description: North Palm Beach residents and visitors will celebrate Independence Day with a full day of family-friendly activities, live entertainment and fireworks at North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse on July 4.
